sources.title: Indian Currency Classification AI - GitHub
sources.snippet: An AI-powered Indian currency recognition system using Deep Learning and Computer Vision to classify Indian currency notes from images and perform real-time prediction through a webcam. The project uses a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 model with Transfer Learning to recognize different Indian currency denominations such as ₹10, ₹20, ₹50, ₹100, ₹200, and ₹500.
